title: fix(platform-objects): decide the hook panel's execution en-echoes per leaf, and pay round 5's cross-panel exclusion
body:
Part of #19403

Clause-②: no

Round 6 of #19403. The `hook` metadata-form panel's ten remaining en-echoes, decided one leaf at a time, with the reason recorded for each. **With them the panel is finished: zero of its 47 string leaves now echoes its English source in all three locales.**

## The family, and why the leaf count did NOT decide it

Re-measured on this branch's base `0e671d20c` — the four remaining families, in **both** counts:

| family | keys | leaves |
|:--|--:|--:|
| six bare type-display pairs (`seed`·`mapping`·`api`·`doc`·`book`·`capability`) | 6 | **12** |
| `object.fields.enable.*` (+ `validations`) | 9 | 11 |
| **`hook.fields.retryPolicy.*` + `body.memoryMb` + `timeoutMs`  ← taken** | **5** | **10** |
| `report.fields.drilldown` + `runtimeFilter` + `sections.dataset_binding` | 3 | 6 |

This family is **third of four by leaves**, so the tie-break is written down — in the ledger's header and here. Two of the four reasons are ones no other row can offer:

1. **It is the only family that makes the LANDED instrument stronger rather than longer.** PR #19509's cross-panel invariant compares 5 shared `HookBodySchema` children × 2 props × 3 locales = 30 pairs and **excluded 6 of them**, because `hook.fields.body.memoryMb` was itself an en-echo and an unauthored twin carries no evidence. That file asserts the exclusion by name and states that a later round of this card owes it. Deciding `body.memoryMb` here **pays it**: the exclusion set is empty, 30 of 30 pairs are compared, and `memoryMb` is guarded on both panels. Ablation D reds that landed assertion, which is the proof the discharge is real.
2. **It is the remaining half of a measured blind spot, on the panel where the existing pin is blind through a control that is CORRECT.** Round 5 measured `hookForm`'s enumerated-but-unwalked children at **seven** — the five `body.*` plus `retryPolicy.maxRetries` and `retryPolicy.backoffMs` — and closed the five on the `action` side only. The two `retryPolicy` children are what was left.
3. **Evidence density forces per-leaf work**: `body.memoryMb` takes a twin that exists only because round 5 created it; `timeoutMs` takes an authored twin one level down the same panel at a byte-identical `en`; `retryPolicy.*` has no twin anywhere and is composed from this catalog's authored answers for its separate words.
4. **It completes a panel** — recorded as a reason that did **not** decide, because `object` and `report` would complete theirs too.

And why **not** the six bare pairs, which lead by leaves: round 5's refusal stands unchanged — only a real panel keeps the DERIVED-POPULATION property with a working dark control, and six unrelated types degenerate the derivation into six one-entry lookups with nothing for the control to exclude.

## The ten decisions

Every verdict is `translate` in all three locales; every row records the authored leaf its wording came from.

| leaf | `en` | zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES | evidence shape |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `body.memoryMb.label` | `Memory Mb` | 内存（MB） · メモリ（MB） · Memoria (MB) | the twin **round 5 created** — copied verbatim |
| `body.memoryMb.helpText` | `Per-invocation memory cap (MB, max 256)` | 单次调用内存上限（MB，最大 256） · 呼び出しごとのメモリ上限（MB、最大 256） · Límite de memoria por invocación (MB, máx. 256) | same twin; `256` kept as a numeral (`ScriptBodySchema.max(256)`) |
| `timeoutMs.label` | `Timeout Ms` | 超时（毫秒） · タイムアウト（ms） · Tiempo de espera (ms) | authored twin **one level down the same panel** |
| `timeoutMs.helpText` | `Abort the hook after N milliseconds` | 超过 N 毫秒后中止该钩子 · N ミリ秒経過後にフックを中止 · Abortar el hook después de N milisegundos | the #19430 **near-miss**, cleared at the schema; `N` kept |
| `retryPolicy.label` | `Retry Policy` | 重试策略 · 再試行ポリシー · Política de reintentos | composed from two authored answers in this catalog |
| `retryPolicy.helpText` | `Retry on failure — most useful for async hooks` | 失败时重试——对异步钩子最有用 · 失敗時に再試行 — 非同期フックで特に有用 | `async` read at the schema: a boolean, not a token |
| `retryPolicy.maxRetries.label` | `Max Retries` | 最大重试次数 · 最大再試行回数 · Reintentos máximos | extractor humanize rendered as the concept |
| `retryPolicy.maxRetries.helpText` | `Maximum retry attempts` | 最多可重试的次数 · 再試行の最大回数 · Número máximo de reintentos | the schema default `3` deliberately **not** rendered |
| `retryPolicy.backoffMs.label` | `Backoff Ms` | 退避（毫秒） · バックオフ（ms） · Retroceso (ms) | `sys_job_queue.fields.backoff_type.label`'s authored answer |
| `retryPolicy.backoffMs.helpText` | `Delay between retries (ms)` | 两次重试之间的延迟（毫秒） · 再試行間の遅延（ms） · Retraso entre reintentos (ms) | same vocabulary; default `1000` not rendered |

**What was refused.** Four of the five labels are the extractor's humanize of a camelCase key, not authored English — exactly where round 5's phantom-translation reading bites. `Memory Mb` → `Memory (MB)` or `Max Retries` → `Max Retries (3)` would differ in bytes, **pass the echo predicate in all three locales, drop the census by a key and tell a zh-CN author nothing.** Every one is rendered into the locale's own writing system instead, and the enumerated verdicts — not the census — are what shows it.

## The #19430 discipline, and the near-miss this family had to clear

Read at the schema before a word was rendered, and **asserted against the live `HookSchema`** rather than described:

- `timeoutMs.helpText` says "Abort the hook after N milliseconds", and `abort` **is** a legal value of `HookSchema.onError` (`z.enum(['abort','log'])`). The near-miss is real. It is **cleared** because the key this tooltip describes takes a **number** — the schema accepts `5000` and refuses `"5000 毫秒"` — so no rendered word can land in it, and the schema's own description uses the word as the runtime's verb ("before the hook is aborted"). Rendered.
- `retryPolicy.helpText` names `async`. `HookSchema.async` is `z.boolean().default(false)` — accepts `true`, refuses `"异步"` — so it is **not** a #19430 token. Rendered, taking this panel's own authored 异步 / 非同期 / Asíncrono one entry up.
- `retryPolicy` is a `strictObject`, not an enum; its alias map governs KEY spellings, which no label renders. Its defaults are `{maxRetries: 3, backoffMs: 1000}` and neither tooltip carries a number — asserted both ways.
- `N` and `256` are kept verbatim, and the token guard now judges **Unicode word boundaries** rather than substring containment: `'Número máximo de reintentos'.includes('N')` is `true`, so round 5's containment check would have passed a locale that lost the placeholder entirely. That is a control, and ablation E reds it.

## A second act: `body.capabilities` reworded on both panels

Round 5 **recorded rather than improved** that zh-CN 功能 and ja-JP 機能 read "feature" for what is a capability **token** from the `HookBodyCapability` enum — and left the reword to the hook family, because both forms declare the same schema key and diverging is the defect the cross-panel invariant guards. This round is the hook family.

The replacement is **derived, not invented**: every authored leaf of the objects catalog whose English names a capability renders it **能力** (zh-CN) and **ケイパビリティ** (ja-JP), and none of them uses 功能 or 機能. The ledger asserts that derivation over the catalog rather than quoting it. es-ES already read `Capacidades` — the same word those leaves use — and is **unchanged**, which is why the zh-CN and ja-JP bundle diffs are two lines larger than es-ES's. The neighbouring senses (`object.sections.capabilities` = 功能开关, the feature CHECKBOXES; `agent.sections.capabilities` = 能力配置) are deliberately untouched and pinned as such.

## The measurements, each with its control in the same run

| reading | base `0e671d20c` | head |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `en` string leaves / `.label` leaves | 893 / 538 | 893 / 538 — same population |
| label keys echoing in ALL THREE | **23** ⇒ 69 `.label` leaves | **18** ⇒ **54** |
| POSITIVE CONTROL — labels genuinely translated | 515 · 499 · 499 | **520 · 504 · 504** |
| decidable sibling remainder (label + its helpText/description) | 39 | **29** |
| `hook` panel leaves echoing in all three | 10 of 47 | **0 of 47** |

Echoes −5 keys, control +5 in each locale, same population, same run. **Two counts for two questions** — the headline moves by 5 because only labels are counted, while this round decided 5 labels **and** 5 helpTexts.

- **No key added or removed.** Full flattened key sets, base vs head, all four bundles: 893 / 893, 0 added, 0 removed — with a negative control proving the comparator sees a one-key delta in both directions (`hook.fields.__probe__.label`). `en` is untouched.
- **Regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`**, never by hand. It dropped exactly the 10 decided leaves' provenance rows in each of the three locales (30 rows, listed in full in the report comment) and **added none**; the metadata-forms bundles round-tripped byte-identical.
- **Bundle diffs**: zh-CN 12/12, ja-JP 12/12, es-ES 10/10 — insertions equal deletions in every bundle. The two extra lines per CJK bundle are the `capabilities` reword on the two panels; es-ES needed none.

## The concurrent PR that held this region

**PR #19520 HAD LANDED** by the time of the pre-push merge — so the required check was **not vacuous**, and it passes. Its leaf is `view.fields.userFilters.helpText`, and in all three bundles this branch carries `origin/main`'s value, not the base's:

```
base  快速筛选栏：控件样式（下拉 / 标签页 / 开关）+ 暴露的字段或标签页预设
main  快速筛选栏：控件样式（dropdown / tabs / toggle）+ 暴露的字段或标签页预设
head  快速筛选栏：控件样式（dropdown / tabs / toggle）+ 暴露的字段或标签页预设
```

`base != main` (the fix moved it) and `head == main` (it survived) hold for `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`. The merge brought its one-line-per-bundle change in cleanly, exactly as the dispatch's five-round measurement predicted. That changeset — `19430-user-filters-element-tokens` — is **this card's own round-2 finding** coming back fixed by another seat, so silently reverting it would have been this lane undoing its own filed work.

## The instrument — five ledgers extended, not rebuilt

`hook-execution-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` carries every property the five earlier rounds established, plus two this family added:

- the echo-reason rule as a **predicate with a dark control** (proved on a synthetic row, since every verdict here is `translate`);
- the panel population **DERIVED** from the `en` catalog, with a dark control naming keys that exist on other types — including `action`'s own `body.memoryMb` at a byte-identical `en`;
- the **second witness** over the three `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` companions, with its own pattern-matched dark control;
- the `en` source pinned **equal** to the live bundle, for the decisions **and** the rewords;
- the **machine-token guard**, upgraded to Unicode word boundaries — the new part, forced by a bare `N`;
- the **cross-panel invariant**, now at 30/30 with a `compared` counter keeping it lit;
- the **composite blind spot** on the hook side, closed.

`action-body-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` is updated in the same PR: its exclusion set is emptied, its lit assertion becomes a counted 30, and the prose that quoted the old capability wording now points at the derivation behind the new one.

### Five ablations, ten assertions, two files

Each ran mutation → run → restore inside **one** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` process, which proves the mutation landed by blob hash and proves the restore by `blob == HEAD` plus an empty `git diff HEAD`. No rebuild is involved: these tests resolve the bundles as sibling sources, not through `dist`.

| # | mutation | assertions reddened |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | re-fill `zh-CN hook.fields.retryPolicy.label` with its `en` | `zh-CN: every decided leaf matches its verdict`; `no leaf on this panel reads its en source…` |
| B | reword the `en` source under the pinned row | `every row is pinned to the live en source`; `the echo predicate can say "echo"` |
| C | put a decided leaf's provenance row back | `zh-CN: no decided leaf is still recorded as an extractor fill` |
| D | render `body.memoryMb` differently on the two panels | **round 5's landed invariant** `the half NO single-panel pin can see`; `30 of 30 pairs agree`; `the invariant can fire` |
| E | drop the `N` placeholder from the es-ES tooltip | `the machine tokens… are still verbatim`; `the token predicate can say NO` |

## Changeset — measured, not assumed

`@objectstack/platform-objects` is `private: false` with `files: ["dist", …]`, and the decided strings reach `dist`: each appears in **6** built files, escaped (`\uXXXX` upper-case hex, and `\xNN` for U+0080–U+00FF — `Pol\xEDtica de reintentos`). A **raw un-escaped negative control** reads **0 including for the positive controls**, so a zero in the raw column means "escaped", not "absent", and a never-written string reads 0 in both columns. ⇒ a **`patch`** changeset; `skip-changeset` is measurably wrong.

## Acceptance notes

**Zero cards to file, and that is a reading rather than a silence.** The leaf that could have carried the known #19430 trap is `hook.fields.timeoutMs.helpText`, whose `abort` **is** a real `HookSchema.onError` enum value — it was checked at the schema, found to describe a numeric key, and cleared, with the check asserted in the ledger so a schema change reds it. `retryPolicy.helpText`'s `async` was checked the same way and is a boolean. Neither is a defect, and neither is a card.

Noted, not filed:

- **`hook.label` is `Gancho` in es-ES while every es-ES sentence on the panel says `hook`** (`hook.sections.identity.description`, `hook.fields.condition.helpText`, `hook.fields.async.helpText`, and now `timeoutMs.helpText`, which copies that convention). This is a wording inconsistency inside one panel, not a reproducible defect, not a contract violation, and not a metadata-authoring trap — the author writes neither word. Carrier: 无 (no PR or person is queued to touch this file for it); it belongs to whichever round of #19403 takes a family that renders the type's own display pair. Dedupe words: `es-ES`, `Gancho`, `hook.label`, `metadata-forms`, `panel vocabulary`.
- **`permission.fields.systemPermissions.helpText` renders "system capability keys" as システム機能キー in ja-JP**, which is the word this PR just replaced for the hook body's capability tokens — but that leaf is a *permission* capability, a different sense, and it is authored and outside this family. Recorded so a later round does not read this PR's reword as a sweep. Carrier: 无. Dedupe words: `ja-JP`, `機能`, `ケイパビリティ`, `systemPermissions`, `capability wording`.

Neither carries `class: a|b|c` evidence, so by this round's reporting contract both stay here as prose.
